verdict.rationale: Google Calendar offers appointment booking pages, so automated reminder and follow-up sequences are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never documents email or SMS reminder or follow-up sequences tied to bookings. API push notifications and change-sync are developer building blocks for monitoring resource changes, not a reminder or follow-up capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows
